overall_assessment: Anonymization works well for UiT. None of the 28 sampled plans has personal data left in, and a scan of all 3154 UiT plans found no role-plus-name lines and no e-mail addresses. The one course leader in the sample ('Emneleder … @uit.no', PFF-1020 2018) was removed, as were exam dates and times, the Leganto semester labels (-H23, HØST 2025, (VÅR 2024)) and 'Publisert høst 2015'. Reference authors, content years and government-document dates were kept. Every pre-pass flag was a false alarm: name_label matched 'naturfaglærer\nStudiepoengreduksjon' and 'emneansvarlig\nEksamen' across a line break, phone matched digits in DOIs, ISSNs and URLs, and admin_date matched 'Høst 10 stp' credit lines and retrieval dates next to Udir documents. What remains is cosmetic leftovers from date removal, plus a policy question about cohort years.

findings.evidence: Pensumliste for LER-1402, 5-10, 15 stp,  og … Muntlig eksamen	Dato:  – Varighet: 45 Minutter … Pensumliste for LER-2303 Naturfag 5-10 -
findings.description: When a date or a semester label is removed, the separators that joined it to the rest of the line stay behind, so the line ends in a dangling connector. Raw 'Pensumliste for LER-1402, 5-10, 15 stp, høst 2019 og vår 2020' becomes '… 15 stp,  og'. 'Naturfag 5-10 - HØST 2025' becomes 'Naturfag 5-10 -'. The exam date range 'Dato: 29.04.2024 –30.04.2024' becomes 'Dato:  –'. 'LRU-3300, autumn 2018: Readings' becomes 'LRU-3300, : Readings' (uit_LRU-3300-1_2018_autumn_1). The packet has 5 of 28 courses like this. Across all UiT plans: 108 of 773 'Pensumliste' lines end in '-', ',' or ', og', and 54 plans have 'Dato:  –'. Outside the packet, removed access dates leave '[]' (LRU-2150, 9 offerings), '[Lesedato ]' (29) and '(Hentet )' (11). No content is lost and no personal data is exposed. These are cosmetic text_corruption, slightly worse than the harmless dangling labels the rubric allows, because '-', ', og' and '[]' read as broken text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In .anon_generic() (R/anonymize.R), the season+year rule `\b(?i:season)\s*\d{4}\b` removes only the label. The semester-code rule just below it already consumes an optional leading `[ \t]*[-–]?[ \t]*`, but the season+year rule does not. The dd.mm.yyyy rule removes each end of a date range separately and leaves the dash between them. The empty-bracket cleanup `[ \t]+\([ \t]*\)` handles only round brackets.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_generic(): (1) let the season+year rule consume a preceding `[ \t]*[-–,][ \t]*` when the label is the last thing on the line, and remove a dangling `[ \t]*,[ \t]*(?:og|and)?[ \t]*$` or `[ \t]+[-–]$` left on the same line ('15 stp,  og', '5-10 -'). (2) Remove a date range as one unit: `\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{4}[ \t]*[-–][ \t]*\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{4}`. (3) Extend the emptied-bracket cleanup to `[ \t]+\[[ \t]*\]`. Add cases for all three to tests/testthat/test-anonymize.R.

findings.evidence: Emnet er obligatorisk for studenter på lektorutdanning i språk og samfunnsfag (kull 2010-2012)
findings.description: Years that say which admission cohorts or which study-plan version a course applies to stay in the course_plan. Examples: '(kull 2010-2012)', '(fra og med kull 2013)' and 'studenter opptatt på studieplan som gjelder fra og med 2013'. In the packet only one course has them; across UiT, 239 of 3154 offerings (about 8%) do, mostly lektorutdanning plans from 2012–2018. They are administrative validity stamps rather than course content, and they date the plan. The generic rule already strips the near-identical 'gjeldende fra 2023' and 'gyldig fra 2023'. The academic-year rule keeps '2010-2012' only because the two years are not consecutive. This is a judgment call: the cohort range also tells which programme version the course belongs to. That is why confidence is low.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In .anon_generic(), the admin-keyword year rule `(?i:opprettet|…|gjeldende(?: fra)?|gyldig(?: fra)?|…)\s+\d{4}` has neither 'gjelder fra (og med)' nor 'kull'. `.drop_academic_year()` removes only consecutive year pairs.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide the policy and record it in methods.qmd. If cohort and plan-validity years count as administrative, add `gjelder fra(?: og med)?|(?:fra og med )?kull(?:et)?` to the admin-keyword year rule in .anon_generic() and let it also take a following `[ \t]?[-–][ \t]?\d{4}` range ('kull 2010-2012' → 'kull'). If they count as content, write that down so later audits stop flagging them.
